html:
G'oya

So'zni oxiridan boshiga qarab yurib, harflarni bittadan yangi satrga qo'shamiz. Har qadamda pos bittaga kamayadi va shu o'rindagi harf acc ning oxiriga yopishadi. pos 0 ga tushganda acc da tayyor teskari so'z turadi.

Yechim

WITH RECURSIVE r(id, pos, acc) AS (
  SELECT id, LENGTH(word), '' FROM words
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.id, r.pos - 1, r.acc || SUBSTR(w.word, r.pos, 1)
  FROM r
  JOIN words w ON w.id = r.id
  WHERE r.pos > 0
)
SELECT id, acc AS reversed
FROM r
WHERE pos = 0

Har bir so'z uchun bir nechta qator chiqadi: salom uchun oltita, pos 5 dan 0 gacha. Kerakligi oxirgisi, uni WHERE pos = 0 tanlaydi. Rekursiv qismdagi JOIN words so'zning o'zini olish uchun kerak, chunki CTE'da faqat id saqlanadi.

Bo'sh satr alohida ishlov talab qilmaydi: LENGTH('') 0, boshlang'ich qatorning o'zi pos = 0, acc = ''.

Tuzoqlar

To'xtash shartida bitta ortiqcha birlik: WHERE r.pos > 1. Rekursiya pos = 1 da to'xtaydi va birinchi harf qo'shilmay qoladi, salom dan mola chiqadi. Natijani pos = 1 bo'yicha tanlasangiz, bo'sh satr ham yo'qoladi, chunki unda bunday qator yo'q:

Noto'g'riWITH RECURSIVE r(id, pos, acc) AS (
  SELECT id, LENGTH(word), '' FROM words
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.id, r.pos - 1, r.acc || SUBSTR(w.word, r.pos, 1)
  FROM r
  JOIN words w ON w.id = r.id
  WHERE r.pos > 1
)
SELECT id, acc AS reversed
FROM r
WHERE pos = 1

Dialektlar farqi

PostgreSQL'da tayyor REVERSE funksiyasi bor. SQLite'da esa yo'q, u yerda bu so'rov no such function: REVERSE xatosini beradi:

Faqat PostgreSQLSELECT id, REVERSE(word) AS reversed
FROM words
